description: Search a spherical radius around a center point for blocks matching any of the given ids (e.g. minecraft:diamond_ore). Searches outward from the center, so the nearest blocks are always covered; a scan budget of 250,000 positions may stop it early (truncated=true, searchedRadius tells how far it got). Returns matches sorted by distance. Only searches loaded chunks.

dimension.description: Dimension id, e.g. "minecraft:overworld", "minecraft:the_nether". Defaults to the current/overworld dimension.

name: find_blocks
title: Find nearby blocks by id
